source_scope: adopted publisher Version of Record full HTML; standalone appendices logged but not imported as unseen new Stage-A evidence
source_loci: empirical softmax response model and parameter recovery
internal_state: posterior mean and variance over latent environmental state
source parameters including volatility update rate, initial volatility and binary inference noise omega
action_or_control_variables: core VKF is an inference/learning model; empirical choice analyses feed learned predictions/action values into a separate softmax response rule
update_operators: Kalman-like posterior mean/variance update with inferred process variance
volatility error-correction update using expected squared state change minus prior volatility
binary moment-matching update for Bernoulli/sigmoid observations
value_or_policy_quantities: predicted reward/outcome probability and action value used by empirical response model; softmax beta is response noise, not learning state
gating_or_selection_rules: no extra coordinator; inferred volatility modulates latent-space learning rate through the source VKF update
learning_rule: joint online inference of state and volatility; lambda=0 is the source fixed-volatility/Kalman special case
temporal_ordering: when fitting choices, pass prediction/value to softmax response model
environmental_or_task_variables: true hidden contingency and experimenter-generated switching/change points are external; some switching simulations deliberately differ from Gaussian-random-walk assumptions
source_defined_controller_hierarchy: state/volatility inference and optional choice readout are distinct source components; neither is promoted to a new coordinator
negative_or_adverse_results: exact inference is unavailable and approximation is required
binary outcomes require moment matching and an inference-only noise parameter
some switching dynamics do not match source random-walk generative assumptions
latent-space and observation-space implied learning rates are not equivalent
volatility-rate and initial-volatility recovery are comparatively error-prone
reset_or_reinitialization_boundary: trial/block schedule belongs to experiment design; no hidden reset operator is invented where the source does not specify one
